retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist 1960s novelty aesthetic featuring a central costumed figure, large rounded speech bubbles, and high-contrast sans-serif display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure in a Napoleon costume and mask stands in a sterile studio environment, holding a leash attached to a fire hydrant, framed by large rounded speech bubbles and decorative corner badges containing eclectic typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored between a fire hydrant and a dense block of body text
Large speech bubble at top-left containing primary display text
Decorative rounded-rectangle badge at top-right for secondary display text
Horizontal 'Stereo' banner with double-ended arrows at the extreme top
coreInvariants: The presence of a large, white, rounded-corner speech bubble with a distinct tail pointing to the subject.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central figure, approximately 60% of vertical height, slightly right of center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The fire hydrant in the bottom-left foreground provides a heavy visual weight to balance the text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large orange text in the speech bubble, moves to the central figure, then to the blue badge, and finally down to the body text list.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High amount of neutral, off-white studio floor and wall space surrounding the central elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/Cream background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue and bright orange for primary graphic elements and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan-blue for the decorative badge background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the costume and graphic elements against a low-saturation, high-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric and Grotesque sans-serifs paired with decorative Victorian-revival display faces.
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy, tightly spaced sans-serif capitals.
Secondary display uses high-contrast, ornate serif with decorative flourishes.
Body text uses a standard mid-century grotesque sans-serif.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact modern sans-serif paired with whimsical, historical-revival decorative type.
graphicDevices: Rounded-corner speech bubble with black stroke
Horizontal rule with arrows for 'Stereo' indicator

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and feel of the primary display text.
Captures the Victorian-revival decorative style of the secondary display.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a Napoleon costume and mask standing in a white studio, holding a leash attached to a black fire hydrant. Leave large empty spaces at the top left and top right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white speech bubble in the top left with bold orange sans-serif text. Add a cyan rounded badge in the top right with decorative black serif text. Add a list of lowercase sans-serif text on the right side.

verificationChecks: Is the speech bubble tail pointing to the figure?
Is the primary text orange and all-caps?
Is the fire hydrant present in the bottom left?

adjustableVariables: Color of the speech bubble text
Object at the end of the leash
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and record label logos
Specific facial features of the masked figure

mustAchieve: Flat, graphic quality of the speech bubbles
Intentional use of awkward negative space

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 'Stereo' banner is at the very top edge.
Check that the body text is justified to the right side.
Verify the leash connects the figure to the hydrant.
Confirm the speech bubble has a thin black outline.
recipe.reuseFormula: Place a surreal subject in a neutral studio, frame with 1960s-style graphic containers (bubbles/badges), and use high-contrast, heavy-weight vintage typography.
